issues.where: the whole sheet, the bridge from the pond to orbit (frames 9535 to 9546)
issues.what: the climb goes through a flat graphic of perfect concentric rings on blue that looks like a screensaver or texture, not water seen from above, and it swaps the picture instead of carrying one climb
issues.fix: make the rise one continuous move up from the real pond surface, keeping its banks, mist and light in view as they fall away

issues.where: frames 9337 to 9841, ripple close-up to dark crater to skeleton continent
issues.what: the rise to orbit breaks into three separate pictures (ripples, an almost black blue field with a crater edge, then a planet already in place) with jumps in scale and speed; the ground stops looking like a real view from that height
issues.fix: render one eased climb through cloud height with the crater lake shrinking into the landmass so the view stays believable at each altitude

issues.what: about 20 seconds of almost identical frames: the cloud swirl stays fixed, clouds don't drift, the terminator doesn't move and the camera barely moves, so it reads as a still picture
issues.fix: let the clouds and storm turn and drift, move the terminator/sun glint, and give the camera a slow, weighty drift

issues.where: the lightning over the ice spire, frames 7015 to 7020
issues.what: the bolt holds for six or more frames, drifts across the sky in nearly the same shape and lights almost nothing; the ridge and cloud stay just as dim, so the strike doesn't land
issues.fix: make it a 1–3 frame strike with a flicker and have it light the whole ridge, snow and cloud base for an instant, then go dark

issues.what: the film ends on a slow fade of an unchanging orbit picture to black, so it's a dissolve on a still image, not a move
issues.fix: keep the camera and atmosphere moving through the fade or end on a deliberate cut

issues.where: crater lake shot, frames 8305 to 8310, the haze over the right cliff
issues.what: there's a hard diagonal edge in the haze and light across the cliff and sky, like a layer seam, and the frames are effectively identical
issues.fix: blend the fog layer smoothly and add live mist drift and water movement

issues.where: ice and night shots, frames 7066, 7318 and 7823, the streaks of cloud by the spires
issues.what: the wisps look like flat painted cards and don't seem to move at their own height; the spires read as cut-outs against the sky
issues.fix: use volumetric cloud that drifts with parallax and wraps around the rock

issues.where: crater shore, frames 4221 to 4226, centre of the frame above the rock bench
issues.what: a soft round translucent blob sits there unchanged, like a stray smoke sprite or lens smudge
issues.fix: remove it or replace it with real steam that rises and breaks up

issues.where: frames 2019 to 2271, the skeletal creature on the cliff face
issues.what: the animal looks pressed flat onto the rock like a relief, with no sign of weight or grip, so it reads as a model rather than a climbing animal
issues.fix: give it volume, contact shadows and a weight shift between holds

issues.where: breaking surf behind the flying creature, frames 2501 to 2506
issues.what: the spray barely changes from frame to frame and reads as a fixed white texture, not water breaking with weight
issues.fix: simulate the breaking crest so the spray climbs, falls and thins frame by frame

issues.what: pose and position are almost the same 4 seconds apart, so the stillness reads as a held model
issues.fix: add grazing head moves, breathing and weight shifts

issues.where: red flats, frames 5618 to 5623, left edge
issues.what: a smeared hazy patch on the left looks like a soft-focus artefact instead of real air
issues.fix: replace it with depth-consistent haze or rain that moves
